A340E(Others) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - COMPONENT PARTS INSTALLATION

SST

27. INSTALL MANUAL VALVE LEVER, SHAFT AND OIL SEAL
(a) Using SST, drive in 2 new oil seals.
SST 09350-30020 (09350-07110)
(b) Coat the oil seal lip with MP grease.

AT5238

Spacer

Manual
Valve Lever

Q00775

(c) Install a new spacer to the manual valve lever.
(d) Install the manual valve lever shaft to the transmission case through the manual valve lever.

AT5405

(e) Using a hammer, drive in a new spring pin.

AT5105

(f) Match the manual valve lever indentation with the spacer hole and calk them the punch.
(g) Make sure the shaft rotates smoothly.

Spring
Pin
E-Ring
Lock Pawl

Q00776

28. INSTALL PARKING LOCK PAWL AND ROD
(a) Install the E-ring to the shaft.
(b) Install the parking lock pawl, shaft and spring.
